title: Spicy Korean Chicken Tteok Bowl
description: A flavorful and spicy Korean-inspired bowl dish made with crispy chicken, tteok, and a crunchy slaw.
instructions: 2. In a large bowl, whisk together soy sauce, brown sugar, and Korean chili flakes. Add the chicken and marinate for at least 15 minutes.
3. Line a baking sheet with parchment paper and arrange the marinated chicken in a single layer. Bake for 15-20 minutes or until cooked through.
4. While the chicken is cooking, prepare the slaw by combining sliced jagged pepper, chopped cilantro, and a squeeze of lime juice.
5. Cook the tteok according to package instructions.
6. To assemble the bowls, place a scoop of tteok in the bottom, followed by a piece of cooked chicken, and top with a spoonful of slaw.
